#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class Main {
public:
    class Maxflow {
    public:
        struct Edge {
            int t, rev;
            long long cap, f;
            Edge(int t, int rev, long long cap) : t(t), rev(rev), cap(cap), f(0) {}
        };
        vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
        Maxflow(int n) {
            graph.resize(n);
        }
        void addEdge(int s, int t, long long cap) {
            graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, graph[t].size(), cap));
            graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, graph[s].size() - 1, 0));
        }
        bool dinicBFS(int src, int dest, vector<int>& dist) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), -1);
            dist[src] = 0;
            vector<int> Q(graph.size());
            int sizeQ = 0;
            Q[sizeQ++] = src;
            for (int i = 0; i < sizeQ; i++) {
                int u = Q[i];
                for (Edge& e : graph[u]) {
                    if (dist[e.t] < 0 && e.f < e.cap) {
                        dist[e.t] = dist[u] + 1;
                        Q[sizeQ++] = e.t;
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[dest] >= 0;
        }
        long long dinicDFS(vector<int>& ptr, vector<int>& dist, int dest, int u, long long f) {
            if (u == dest) return f;
            for (; ptr[u] < (int)graph[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
                Edge& e = graph[u][ptr[u]];
                if (dist[e.t] == dist[u] + 1 && e.f < e.cap) {
                    long long df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, e.t, min(f, e.cap - e.f));
                    if (df > 0) {
                        e.f += df;
                        graph[e.t][e.rev].f -= df;
                        return df;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
        long long maxFlow(int src, int dest) {
            long long flow = 0;
            vector<int> dist(graph.size());
            while (dinicBFS(src, dest, dist)) {
                vector<int> ptr(graph.size(), 0);
                while (true) {
                    long long df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, src, LLONG_MAX);
                    if (df == 0) break;
                    flow += df;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    };

    class MinCostFlowBF {
    public:
        struct Edge {
            int to, f, cap, cost, rev;
            Edge(int v, int cap, int cost, int rev) : to(v), cap(cap), cost(cost), rev(rev), f(0) {}
        };
        vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
        MinCostFlowBF(int n) {
            graph.resize(n);
        }
        void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
            graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, cap, cost, graph[t].size()));
            graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, 0, -cost, graph[s].size() - 1));
        }
        void bellmanFord(int s, vector<int>& dist, vector<int>& prevnode, vector<int>& prevedge, vector<int>& curflow) {
            int n = graph.size();
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INT_MAX);
            dist[s] = 0;
            curflow[s] = INT_MAX;
            vector<bool> inqueue(n, false);
            vector<int> q(n);
            int qt = 0;
            q[qt++] = s;
            for (int qh = 0; (qh - qt) % n != 0; qh++) {
                int u = q[qh % n];
                inqueue[u] = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[u].size(); i++) {
                    Edge& e = graph[u][i];
                    if (e.f >= e.cap) continue;
                    int v = e.to;
                    int ndist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                    if (dist[v] > ndist) {
                        dist[v] = ndist;
                        prevnode[v] = u;
                        prevedge[v] = i;
                        curflow[v] = min(curflow[u], e.cap - e.f);
                        if (!inqueue[v]) {
                            inqueue[v] = true;
                            q[qt++ % n] = v;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        vector<int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
            int n = graph.size();
            vector<int> dist(n), curflow(n), prevedge(n), prevnode(n);
            int flow = 0;
            int flowCost = 0;
            while (flow < maxf) {
                bellmanFord(s, dist, prevnode, prevedge, curflow);
                if (dist[t] == INT_MAX) break;
                int df = min(curflow[t], maxf - flow);
                flow += df;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                    Edge& e = graph[prevnode[v]][prevedge[v]];
                    e.f += df;
                    graph[v][e.rev].f -= df;
                    flowCost += df * e.cost;
                }
            }
            return {flow, flowCost};
        }
    };

    void solve(istream& in, ostream& out) {
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
        int n, m, k, c, d;
        in >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
        vector<int> pos(n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x;
            in >> x;
            pos[x - 1]++;
        }
        int T = 100;
        MinCostFlowBF mf((T + 1) * n + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (pos[i] > 0)
                mf.addEdge(0, i + 1, pos[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                mf.addEdge(1 + i * n + j, 1 + (i + 1) * n + j, k, 0);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                mf.addEdge(1 + i * n, (T + 1) * n + 1, 1, c * i);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a, b;
            in >> a >> b;
            a--; b--;
            for (int j = 0; j < T; j++) {
                int cost = 0;
                for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                    mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + a, 1 + (j + 1) * n + b, 1, l * l * d - cost);
                    mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + b, 1 + (j + 1) * n + a, 1, l * l * d - cost);
                    cost = l * l * d;
                }
            }
        }
        vector<int> flowAndCost = mf.minCostFlow(0, (T + 1) * n + 1, k);
        cerr << flowAndCost[0] << endl;
        out << flowAndCost[1] << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    Main solver;
    solver.solve(cin, cout);
    return 0;
}
